name: combat-vfx
description: Anime-style combat effects for #html Volt games: power auras, sweeping slashes, hit impacts with freeze-frames, a critical-hit lightning strike, beams, charge orbs, dash afterimages, speed lines and a domain-style void field. Glowing, additive overlay drawn on top of your canvas game.

snippets.label: Combat VFX (aura, slash, impact, crit, beam, orb, domain)
snippets.description: Drop-in effects engine for games that use `canvas`, plus fx* functions: fxAura, fxSlash, fxImpact, fxCrit, fxBeam, fxOrb, fxGhost, fxDomain, fxHitstop and more.
